title: typed.rs and TypedSuffixArray name the type parameter, not the job
body:
`libsufr/src/typed.rs` holds the `.sufr` file after `open`, at one integer width: the public `SourceKind` enum, the crate enums `Text` and `Suffixes` (Memory, Disk, or Subsampled for the suffixes) that record where each part lives, the struct `TypedSuffixArray<T>` with `open`, `load_suffixes`, the subsample and its cache, `suffixes_at`, `lcps_at`, `text_byte` and `searched_ranks`, and three helpers. `search.rs` adds the queries as a second `impl` on the same struct. The public `SuffixArray` in `lib.rs` wraps one of these at u32 or u64.

"Typed" names the type parameter, which the file name does not need to say, and says nothing about the job. Jack called it a 1/10 name on 2026-11-03. The file was `sufr_file.rs` with `SufrFile<T>` on dev, then `index.rs` with `Index<T>` (ad1a659), then this (c6c9b53); all three names came from refactor commits with a Claude line, so none is a person's decision.

## Options

| module, struct | reads as | against |
|---|---|---|
| `reader.rs`, `Reader<T>` | a reader of a `.sufr` file at width T: `Reader::open`, `reader.suffixes_at`, `reader.search` | |
| `storage.rs`, `Loaded<T>` | the module owns where the text and the suffixes live | the struct name is weak |
| `opened.rs`, `Opened<T>` | an opened file | `Opened::open` |
| fold into `search.rs` | one module | 1,400 lines, two jobs |

## Cost

A rename and nothing else, one commit. About 40 mentions of the struct in `lib.rs`, `search.rs`, `typed.rs` and their tests, all crate-private. `SourceKind` keeps its name and re-export.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/16cf998c
notes.text: Commit 9d84fe8 removed `Metadata` from `typed.rs` and from the crate. `sufr summarize` now builds its rows from `Header`. The body's mentions of `Metadata` no longer hold: `typed.rs` no longer holds it, and only `Storage` keeps a re-export.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/16cf998c
notes.text: Commit fce1756 renamed the public enum `Storage` to `SourceKind`. Where this issue says `Storage`, it now means `SourceKind`.
